entries.title: Indices tres Lexicon Suidae compendiose repraesentantes
entries.note: Head SUIDAS. - NOTITIA at 89512, header 1194 three lines after. Notitia is Latin with Greek citations; Greek content of the Indices themselves not checked. The title is as the Elenchus gives it; body heads are Notitia and Indices.

problems: Chain map is poor in this volume (368 anchors for ~1480 cols); bodyCol comes from nearby page-number lines and running heads, not the chain.

Michael Hamartolus (Elenchus 1185) and the start of the Versus politici (Elenchus 1186) are not in the OCR: lines 89124-89360 span cols 1182-1191 in about 236 lines, so several pages are missing or clipped.
The Ordo's column numbers are partly lost: it was used for Menologium and Novellae parts and as a cross-check for Leo Diaconus and the Velitatio. Ordo lines for Hasii and Velitatio read 635 and 926.
Ignatius Drama 1163 is inferred from the page structure (see note); no page number is legible there.
Not entered (not in the Elenchus): Hippolytus Notitia, Georgides Edit..., Suidas index sub-items, and the closing INDICES VOLUMINIS listed in the Ordo.
Leo Diaconus Historiae: the Ordo lists books I-X with columns, but books are subdivisions of one work, so no parts were built.
